scope: Offline document expansion and exact preterminal-state reconstruction supplement; no new counts/services, text/labels/predictions, source modifications, or run mutations.
interpretation: Parent proof sources are expanded to every mapped span in their source documents for the new terminal query identity. This concrete broadening creates extra terminal unread obligations; all expanded spans had already been read during history phases.
Raw sources are still deduplicated by exact alias/original identity in each payload. Re-reading at a different semantic phase is not duplicate wire insertion.
The first terminal output adds a new known terminal route while no new mandatory original source is required. This increases continuation state metadata. Field byte sizes are not token counts.

A mandatory-handoff fit check is not a guarantee of every future terminal window fitting. Whether whole-document re-review is required by the intended method remains a design/implementation-contract question; this report does not authorize dropping sources or bypassing audit.
